'''Lianna''' was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Lianna system/Legends|Lianna system]] in the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]<ref name="DarthPlagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Santhe family/Legends|House Santhe]] and the headquarters of [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]]. Located on the junction of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], the [[Cadinth Run]] and the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]], Lianna was one of the busiest ports in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].

==History==
[[File:Lianna_terrain.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Lianna terrain.]]
Lianna was conquered by many [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] from the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] early history, though it later fell under the jurisdiction of the [[Kingdom of Barseg]] by the time of the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Mission to Lianna" /> Its inhabitants claimed that the planet was never, however, a part of the [[Kingdom of Cron]] or [[Xim's empire]], though this claim to independence was mocked by many other [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]], as during [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] reign Lianna was a bleak agricultural world with a population of only a few thousand.<ref name="Xim Week" />

The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] overlooked Lianna, so the planet continued to be ruled as a traditional territory. At approximately [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]], the Senate eventually decided to take control of Lianna from Barseg, though some two hundred years later, [[Sienar Technologies]] set up operations on Lianna, after the planet continued to be misused as an industrial center even after the Senate's intervention. Soon after, the company was taken over by [[Kerred Santhe]], who moved his company's headquarters to Lianna.<ref name="Mission to Lianna" />

[[File:Lianna.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A city on Lianna.]]

Under the control of Kerred's granddaughter, [[Valles Santhe]], the planet remained independent and proud of its economic power, though it eventually supported the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], during which the [[Battle of Lianna]] was fought. The battle destroyed much of Lianna's urban sprawl.

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Lianna became a supporter of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] until [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] defeat at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

At this point, [[Valles Santhe]] was in control of Lianna and the Allied Tion, and though the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was respectful enough of her command not to intercede on her rule, surviving Imperial forces launched a series of reprisal attacks on the planet. Fortunately, as Lianna produced many of the Empire's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], Santhe was able to hold off the attacks by threatening to cease production. The threat, plus some well-placed bribes, allowed Lianna to remain neutral by special charter of the Empire.<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="Pirates & Privateers">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>

The [[Firebird Society]] was also founded on Lianna.

A standard day on Lianna lasted for twenty-two standard hours, and a year encompassed three hundred and seventy local days.<ref name="Mission to Lianna" />

==Behind the scenes==
The picture from the cover of ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'' re-uses a concept illustration for the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="TISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>
